topic: 3D lidar setup and driver compatibility issues
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the status of connecting a 3D lidar unit in the office. Initial reports indicated connectivity issues, requiring only a new scene recording.

A key technical point was the compatibility issue with the Slamtec driver updated for 2D routers. It was suggested that it would be beneficial to transition to the newer driver version, as this might resolve existing bugs (specifically related to release versions).

Technical difficulties were noted regarding the PCL visualizer being unavailable even when visualization was enabled. The team agreed on testing the new driver version while acknowledging that the current debug version is necessary because the release version crashes with a segmentation fault.
decisions: Test transitioning to the newer lidar driver version
Continue using the debug driver version due to stability issues with the release version
action_items: Someone needs to check and resolve the PCL visualizer availability issue
